scientific_integrity: Unconditional analytic deduction from a published prime-primary criterion and the prime number theorem; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed real moments s>0 only; nonuniform as s approaches zero. Prime-support lemma is prior work; moment asymptotics and second coefficient are the present contribution. Computations are finite consistency checks, not independent proof certification.
title: Two-term moment laws for the binomial row GCD sequence
